independence_basis: ecbench verify --replay-all: separate auditor process re-executes every deterministic (ic.pipeline) run from the session files, recomputes derived figures and re-checks [d]G=Q (docs/ecbench/README.md section 9: the receipt SHA-256 is the repository replay certificate). Same binary and host as the producer; NOT a cross-host replay (ecbench-independent-runner not run). Randomised rho runs (rho-strong, rho-strong-aa) are verified ([d]G=Q) but not replayed.
